decisions.reason: Close to the established offer and inexpensive to keep, so the option remains open while demand uncertainty resolves.
Incremental pegboard variant has low keeping costs, so the firm preserves the option until clearer market signal emerges.
Eighth-pallet display is close to existing products and cheap to retain, so the option is kept open.
Wooden pallet is a larger step from the core cardboard offer with higher keeping costs and no positive signal, so the option should be abandoned.
Media-specific niche may still develop and incremental keeping costs are minimal, so holding the option is justified.
